name: [Katagami] People cannot sign in
message:
Five or more sign-in attempts failed in the last hour, excluding the ones where the person declined the Google consent screen (@reason:consent), which is a choice and not a fault.

The reasons that matter here:
  state — the callback arrived with a code but no matching cookie; usually a cookie or redirect-URI problem
  google — the token exchange with Google failed; check client credentials
  session — our own session signing failed; that is our bug, not Google's

Every one of these is a person who wanted an account and did not get one.

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server%20env%3Aproduction%20%40evt%3Aauth_login_failed
